summary: The compliance review of the QuickLine: Instant Credit Backed by Partner Guarantee product identified two key findings. First, the feature implying that Satpura Finance approves every applicant without its own credit check violates the requirement for robust credit underwriting standards, regardless of the DLG cover. Second, the cooling-off period of 2 days does not comply with the requirement that the cooling-off period must be determined by the RE Board and must not be less than one day.
